package.description: Automatically deduplicate data and compress files in your folders.

en-US.description: Automatically deduplicate data and compress files in your folders.
en-US.longDescription: DupeCare is a free and simple data deduplication and compression software for Windows. It allows you to create folders where redundant data is automatically deduplicated and compressed on the fly, while decompression happens in real time. The utility works at the file system level and provides a reliable and easy to use single-instance storage (SIS) solution for individual folders.
en-US.name: HHD Software DupeCare

zh-CN.description: 自动对文件夹中的数据进行去重和压缩。
zh-CN.longDescription: DupeCare 是一款适用于 Windows 的免费且简单的数据去重与压缩软件。它允许您创建一些文件夹，其中的冗余数据会被自动去重和压缩，而解压缩则实时完成。该实用程序在文件系统级别工作，可为单个文件夹提供可靠且易用的单实例存储（SIS）解决方案。
